description: This PHP trait provides helper methods for handling leave request parameters in an API context, including retrieving, validating, and setting leave-related data such as leave type, dates, comments, durations, and partial options.

classes.name: LeaveRequestParamHelperTrait
classes.description: A PHP trait providing helper methods for extracting, validating, and setting leave request parameters in an API context, including handling leave type, dates, comments, durations, and partial options.

methods.name: getLeaveTypeIdParam
methods.description: Retrieves the leave type ID parameter from the request body.

methods.name: getFromDateParam
methods.description: Retrieves the 'from' date parameter as a DateTime object or null.

methods.name: getToDateParam
methods.description: Retrieves the 'to' date parameter as a DateTime object or null.

methods.name: getCommentParam
methods.description: Retrieves the comment parameter as a string or null.

methods.name: getDurationParam
methods.description: Retrieves a duration array parameter by key, or null.

methods.name: getPartialOptionParam
methods.description: Retrieves the partial option parameter as a string or null.

methods.name: getLeaveRequestParams
methods.description: Constructs and returns a LeaveParameterObject with leave details, setting durations and partial options based on leave type and dates.

methods.name: setMultiDayPartialOptions
methods.description: Sets partial options and durations for multi-day leave requests.

methods.name: setSingleDayDuration
methods.description: Sets the duration for single-day leave requests.

methods.name: getGeneratedDuration
methods.description: Generates a LeaveDuration object based on request parameters and whether it's a single day or multi-day leave.

methods.name: getCommonParamRuleCollection
methods.description: Returns a collection of validation rules for common leave request parameters.

methods.name: getEndpointLogicException
methods.description: Returns a LogicException indicating improper usage outside of an Endpoint context.
